body:
value = read_user()
try:
    finish()
finally:
    send(value)

value = read_user()
try:
    raise ValueError(value)
finally:
    finish()
    send(value)

value = read_user()
try:
    stop(value)
    send('unreachable')
finally:
    finish()
    send(value)

again = True
while again:
    again = False
    try:
        continue
    finally:
        finish()
        send(read_user())

try:
    raise ValueError(read_user())
finally:
    finish()
    raise

value = read_user()
try:
    value = stop()
finally:
    finish()
    send(value)

value = read_user()
try:
    value = choose(value)
finally:
    finish()
    send(value)
